claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a dusty LG Flatron monitor and a keyboard, consistent with items being sold for scrap or in unknown condition.
The photos do not provide evidence of the physical location.

risks.risk: The monitor screen may be cracked, have dead pixels, or vertical lines.
risks.proof: A video of the monitor powered on and displaying a clear, solid-colored image.

risks.risk: The keyboard may have non-functional keys or liquid damage.
risks.proof: A video showing a typing test of all keys.

risks.risk: The specific model and resolution are unknown, affecting the scrap vs. resale value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's sticker on the back of the monitor.
risks.if_unproven: as the oldest, lowest-specification LG Flatron model

risks.risk: Essential power and video cables may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the power cable and VGA/HDMI cables.

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the back of the monitor showing the model number and manufacture date.
Video of the monitor plugged in and turned on.
Photo of the ports on the back of the monitor.
response.reason: The items have been identified by the witness and the seller's own description of 'scrap' allows for a worst-case valuation.
